content:
OpenAI has previewed over 20 announcements for its DevDay 2026 event. The event will be live-streamed. You can see all of today's announcements below.

OpenAI event live stream

We expect the main announcement today to be ChatGPT's answer to SpaceXAI Grok Bot and Meta Muse, expanding on its existing AI agent tools to capture a wider consumer audience.

OpenAI already offers similar features under the umbrella of ChatGPT Work, but their presentation isn't as straightforward as Muse and Grok Bot.

In short, you can watch the live event when it starts on the dot. The event begins at 10 a.m. PT / 1 p.m. ET.

Dots: AI agents that work around the clock

First up: Dots. These are AI agents that work around the clock, a new feature within ChatGPT.

ChatGPT Space

Next is a new feature called ChatGPT Space. It's a collaborative workspace where you can work alongside Dots, manage pages and presentations, and handle living documents.

GPT-6.1 Sol

OpenAI also unveiled information about a new GPT-6.1 Sol model.

OpenAI said: "We're officially launching GPT‑6.1 Sol, an upgrade to GPT‑6 Sol. Its intelligence in agentic coding, computer use, and professional work is nearly on par with GPT‑6 Astra, while standard input and output token pricing is just one-fifth of Astra's."

OpenAI added: "Cached input costs just $0.10 per million tokens — 95% lower than standard input pricing and 50% lower than GPT‑6 Sol's cached input pricing — giving developers more room to build and run powerful agents that reuse context across requests."

You can read more about the new model here.

All the new announcements

While the announcement event is still underway, there's already a complete summary of all of today's announcements on the OpenAI website, including a new $500 per month subscription plan and more.
